            Advanced: L3 expert mirror
            
L3 expert peer mirror (separate from sealed jobs; default OFF): host — l3_expert_mirror.py export-mirror then serve-mirror; consumer — SLIPSTREAM_PGRN_L3=peer + SLIPSTREAM_PGRN_PEER_BASE=http://host:8765. See docs/P2P_MVP.md § L3.

          

          

            

              

                

                
              

              

                

                
              

              

                

                
              

            

            

              
              
              
Traffic is encrypted, but the selected worker decrypts and sees the plaintext prompt for inference. Sensitive and Secret requests stay local by default.

              How to use
              
    
                
    mock = in-process (safe default). mlx/llama/auto = HTTP infer to local Slipstream (:8080) if already running — UI never spawns engines.
    
                
    Does not spawn a second heavy serve. Start Slipstream first for mlx/llama/auto; one Metal or oMLX process only.
    
                
    Two machines: Start node on each (different listen ports), put the other host:port in Bootstrap/Peer, Probe, then Ask. Keep engine=mock until :8080 is already up.
    
                
    When the local server is stopped, Chat also routes here if P2P is enabled.

    Einstellungen
    
          
    
            
    
            
            
    
              
    Modelle größer als RAM streamen von der SSD.
    
              
    Auto: kurz/warm → MLX wenn experts.pgrn, langer Prefill → Metal. Explizite Wahl bleibt sticky.
    
              
    Coding-Preset: Thinking aus, greedy (temp 0).
    
              
    Models folder → Backend Auto → Start
    
            
    
            
    
            
          
    
          
          
    
            Advanced: optional overflow / path overrides
            
    Only if GGUF or MLX live outside the Models folder (second SSD / custom layout).
    
            
    
              
    
              
              
    Optional override. Default is <Models folder>/mlx. Leave alone unless MLX trees live elsewhere.
    
            
    
            
    
              
    
              
              
    Optional overflow. Empty = GGUF next to PGRN in the Models folder.
    
            
    
          
    
          
    
            
    
              
            
    
            
    When on, Chat sends standard OpenAI tools to the active local engine (time + calculator). The Chat toolbar stays in sync.
    
          
    
          
    
            
    Tools / JSON / Schema use the same Chat contract on both engines. Compact + Grammar drafts are Metal-only; choose Metal or Auto for those.
    
          
    
          
          
    
            
    MLX-Defaults: touch · cold_io=0 · balanced · keep-hot. Selten nötig zu ändern.
    
            
    
              Advanced: Profil / Residency / L3 / MCP
              
    
                
              
    
              
    
                
    Passed as SLIPSTREAM_PGRN_* on MLX start. Default: touch + keep-hot + io16 (no cold boost). mlock opt-in. Prefetch stays off unless set outside the app.
    
                
    Memory guard: default is --memory-guard-gb = total RAM − 3 GiB headroom. Long coding/full-PGRN can hit the Metal wired cap (~28 GiB) and fail with prefill_memory_exceeded — close apps, shrink context, enable “Memory guard off” below, or raise iogpu.wired_limit_mb (sudo). Cold-io stays 0 (profile io16). Start refuses if free+inactive < 4 GiB; warns below 8 GiB.
    
              
    
              
    
                
              
    
              
    
                
    
                  
    
                  
                  
    Caps: capacity 4096 · hot 2048 · io_width 16
    
                
    
                
    
                  
    
                  
                
    
              
    
              
    
                
              
    
              
    
                
              
    
              
    
                
    
                
                
    Empty = L3 OFF. Non-empty sets SLIPSTREAM_PGRN_L3=peer + PEER_BASE on MLX start.
    
              
    
              
    
                
    
                
                
    Empty = MCP OFF. Non-empty sets OMLX_MCP_CONFIG + --mcp-config so oMLX merges server tools into chat/messages/responses.
